battle.name: 潞州之戰
battle.brief: 天祐四年（九零七）春，晉王李克用攻後梁昭義節度使符存佑據守的潞州，梁遣張文蔚率軍往援，晉軍夜襲破其營於城下，符存佑旋為部將所殺，潞州遂歸晉。卡面投石機為配重式拋射器，與本役相隔千餘年，不可能現身；當時中原攻城倚賴同原理的拋石機壓制城頭守軍，本役是否實置則史無明文。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是後梁與晉王李克用為爭奪昭義節度使治所潞州而爆發的對抗，時間在天祐四年（九零七）春。後梁是朱全忠於同年正月逼唐哀帝禪位建立的政權，定都汴梁，控制河南、河北與關中大部，常備骨幹為宣武軍的禁軍與河北各州縣的鎮兵，徵發與調度由樞密院一體承擔。晉方是李克用據守太原的河東軍，骨幹為沙陀騎兵以及河東各部落的馬軍，輔以州縣團練的步卒與工程兵，動員依靠節度使衙門的文書與部曲的私兵關係，兩套體制的作戰節奏與補給方式截然不同。潛伏在兩者之間的第三方是昭義軍本身：昭義節度使孟方立於唐天祐二年（九零五）死後，兵權由內牙出身的符存佑掌握，符存佑遣使降梁，梁廷授其昭義節度使名號，等於在李克用的南翼插上一枚釘子。河北一帶如趙州、魏州的節度使多持觀望態度，既不協助救援，也不支援李克用，使潞州一役始終是一場兩方直接對決的局部戰役，沒有第三方的介入可以借力。
countriesEn: This war was a clash between the Later Liang and Li Keyong's Jin for Zhaoyi circuit and its seat at Luzhou, fought in the spring of 907 (Tianyou 4). The Later Liang was the state Zhu Quanzhong founded in the first month of that year after forcing the last Tang emperor, Ai, to abdicate; it sat at Bianliang, controlled most of Henan and Hebei and parts of Guanzhong, and drew its hard core from the Xuanwu Army's imperial guard and the county levies of the Hebei circuits, with mobilisation and dispatch carried out together by the military affairs commission. The Jin side was the Hedong army Li Keyong held at Taiyuan, its backbone the Shatuo cavalry together with the mounted contingents of the Hedong tribes, supplemented by militia footmen and engineers from the prefectures and counties, mustered through the documents of the jiedushi headquarters and the private soldier relationships of his retainers; the two systems therefore fought at different rhythms and were supplied in different ways. A third party lay between them: the Zhaoyi army itself. After the Zhaoyi jiedushi Meng Fangli died in 905, control of the troops passed to Fu Cunyou, an officer of the neiya guard, and Fu Cunyou sent envoys to surrender to the Liang, the Liang court giving him the title of Zhaoyi jiedushi, which was a nail driven into Li Keyong's southern flank. The jiedushi of the Hebei circuits around Zhaozhou and Weizhou for the most part watched without acting, neither aiding the relief army nor backing Li Keyong, so the battle of Luzhou remained throughout a local contest fought directly between the two sides, with no third party whose strength could be borrowed.
people: 主導攻勢的是晉王李克用。他出身沙陀，自河東起兵，逐步控制並州、忻州、代州一帶，把太原經營成北方最硬的一塊騎兵基地；對他而言，潞州不是一座邊城，而是通向河北的門戶，一旦讓後梁據此設防，太原的南面就永久暴露在敵軍矛頭之下，因此他寧可把騎兵拉出很遠也要拔掉這枚釘子。守方是符存佑，這位昭義軍內牙出身的節度使並非朝廷舊臣一系，其權位完全來自對軍隊的控制；他曾向李克用示好，又轉投後梁，在兩邊都落下不信任，這使他在城破之日失去了任何一方的支持。梁方主帥是張文蔚，字右華，河間張氏人，乾符二年（八七五）進士，天祐二年（九零五）以同平章事拜相，兼領太原行營招討使，統梁軍往救潞州；史家記其人持重而失於拘泥，兵至城下逗留不進，坐失晉軍夜襲之機。孟方立之死則是全案的導火線。另外，傳世史籍並未逐一列出晉軍將校的姓名，只以河東精騎概之；周德威、史建瑭等李克用麾下的名將同在此一時期活躍於河東，具體是否臨陣，記載含糊，難以斷言，故此役的勝負關鍵仍只能落在李克用本人的決斷與符存佑部下的分裂上。
peopleEn: The offensive was directed by Jin Prince Li Keyong. A Shatuo by birth, he had risen in Hedong and taken control of Bingzhou, Xinzhou and Daizhou in turn, turning Taiyuan into the hardest cavalry base in the north; for him Luzhou was not a border town but a gateway into Hebei, and once the Liang were allowed to fortify it his southern flank at Taiyuan would stand permanently exposed to the enemy's spear, so he was willing to take his cavalry a long way out rather than leave the nail in place. The defender was Fu Cunyou, a jiedushi who had risen out of the Zhaoyi neiya guard and did not belong to the old establishment of the court, his standing resting entirely on his control of the troops; he had first made overtures to Li Keyong and then turned to the Later Liang, which left him trusted by neither side, and that is why he found no protection on the day the city fell. The Liang commander was Zhang Wenwei, courtesy name Youhua, of the Zhang clan of Hejian, a jingkongzi of 875, appointed chancellor with joint signature of the Zhongshu and Menxia in 905, and at the same time holding the post of commissioner of the Taiyuan field army sent to relieve Luzhou; the historians record him as careful but too bound by form, his troops reaching the neighbourhood of the city and then dawdling instead of advancing, and so losing the chance to strike the Jin in the night. The death of Meng Fangli was the fuse of the whole affair. As for the Jin commanders, the transmitted histories name no one of them, using only a general phrase about the elite cavalry of Hedong; men such as Zhou Dewei and Shi Jianhuang were active in Hedong in these same years under Li Keyong, but whether they stood in the line is vague in the record and cannot be settled, so the decisive weight of the battle falls on Li Keyong's own judgement and on the division inside Fu Cunyou's command.
kits: 卡面這件投石機屬地中海世界：它是配重式拋射器，靠絞盤拉緊長杆、蓄起配重的勢能，鬆手把石塊甩向目標，前二五〇年前後已在羅馬與希臘世界的守城戰中出現，比本役早了一千一百五十餘年，因此不可能出現在九零七年的潞州城下。但同一套物理原理在當時的中原並不陌生，只是形制與名稱不同：唐代文獻稱之為拋石機或砲，用木架、長杆與配重箱造成，發射石彈或陶彈，架設一次便需大量木料、繩索與隨軍工匠，石彈還要就地採石製坯。《資治通鑑》記會昌年間唐軍攻襄陽，拋石機所發石彈擊中城堞即成孔穴，屢次打穿城頭女牆並造成守軍死傷，可見其在攻城中的位置。潞州城屬夯土築城，這類土城牆正是拋石機最對付的目標：石彈不必破城，主要用來打塌垛口、壓制城頭弓弩手，並封住守軍集結的馬面；對磚石包砌的堅城效果有限，因此器械的實際威力取決於城牆材質與攻方的工期。除拋石機外，進攻方還需雲梯飛梯、蒙皮大幄以隔絕矢石、穴地以穿牆，輔以填壕、架橋、破門的連續動作；守方則備弓弩，並依唐代兵器書所載置竹飛石一類的拋射器具，牆頭備滾木與拒馬，門口設障，並以水井與河渠供水，在城頭向下傾倒熱水與火油。馬匹與糧秣同樣是裝備的一部分：晉軍的坐騎是沙陀的北地馬，靠短距離機動取勝；梁軍遠道而來，糧道橫跨河北，補給線比攻城器械更容易被切斷。
kitsEn: The onager on the card belongs to the Mediterranean world: a counterweight engine that winds a long arm back with a windlass, stores the potential energy of the counterweight, and, when the catch is released, flings a stone at the target; machines of this kind were already at work in the sieges of the Roman and Greek world around 250 BC, some eleven and a half centuries before this campaign, so they cannot have stood below the walls of Luzhou in 907. The same physical principle was not, however, unknown in the central plains of the time, though the form and the name differed: Tang sources call the machine a pao-shi ji or simply a pao, built of a timber frame, a long throwing arm and a counterweight box, firing stone or ceramic shot, and requiring on every emplacement a great quantity of timber, rope and skilled artificers carried with the army, the shot itself having to be made from stone quarried on the spot. The Zizhi Tongjian records, for the fighting at Xiangyang in the Huichang era, that the stones thrown by such machines punched holes in the crenellations as they struck, repeatedly breaking the parapet on the wall head and killing and wounding the defenders, which shows the place such a machine held in a siege. The walls of Luzhou were rammed earth, and a rammed-earth wall was exactly the target such a machine suited: the shot did not need to breach the wall, it was there to smash the merlons, to pin down the archers on the parapet, and to seal off the stretches of the face where the defenders gathered; against a wall faced in brick and stone it was far less effective, so the real power of the engine depended on the material of the curtain and on how long the besiegers could afford to stay before it. Besides the engine, the assault needed scaling ladders, great hide-covered shelters to keep off arrows and stones, and mining under the wall, worked in sequence with filling the ditch, bridging it and breaking the gate; the defenders had bows and crossbows, and according to Tang arsenals the flying stones of the bamboo tube, with rolling logs and caltrops set along the wall head, barriers at the gates, and water drawn from wells and channels for the city, pouring hot water and fire oil down upon the men at the foot of the wall. Horses and grain were part of the equipment as well: the Jin rode northern horses of the Shatuo kind and won by short bursts of speed, whereas the Liang came from far away with their line of supply crossing all of Hebei, and a commissariat was far easier to cut than a siege engine.
tactics: 晉軍採取的是典型的圍點打援之勢：以步兵與器械分屯潞州城下完成圍攻，主力騎兵則佈於城北與城東一帶的山岡樹林之間待機，專等梁軍援兵走完整程山路再行出擊。真正的破局在夜襲。夜裡視線短，馬蹄聲可以用沙土與就地徵發的柴草掩蓋，晉軍選擇無月或月色黯淡之夜逼近梁軍營寨，先以小股騎兵焚燒外圍的草料、帳幕與柵欄，再趁亂突入營中；梁軍是步多騎少的混成縱隊，一旦營地被火分隔，就難以收攏與反擊。晉軍同樣不與梁軍正面硬拼，攻營之後立刻收兵退回山林，把追擊引向自己的射程與標槊射程之內，發揮騎兵機動與投射兵器射程的長處。守方符存佑的部署則是死守待援：城頭分番守夜，出城騷擾不多，完全寄望於援軍打通通道；可惜援軍選擇的集結地距城不過十數里，晉軍的攔截陣地恰好卡在城與援軍之間，城中無法與援軍互相聲援，士氣隨糧援俱盡而崩。最後解決僵局的不是攻城器械，而是昭義軍內部的分裂：符存佑的內牙部眾不滿他改投後梁，趁夜發動，將符存佑殺死並開城迎降，晉軍入城。這也是本役最值得記取的一點：夯土城牆在配重式拋石機面前其實可以撐很久，最終決定城防崩壞的，是守軍的政治忠誠。
tacticsEn: The Jin used the classic pattern of besieging a point in order to strike a relief force: infantry and engines were distributed about Luzhou to complete the investment, while the main body of cavalry waited in the hills and woods north and east of the city, holding itself for the moment when the Liang column would have finished its long climb out of the mountains. The decisive stroke was the night attack. In darkness sight is short, the movement of hooves can be muffled with sand and with brushwood gathered on the spot, and the Jin chose a night without moon or with the moon dim, crept up to the Liang camp, and sent in small bodies of horsemen to burn the fodder, the tents and the palisades on the outer edge before breaking in among the confusion. The Liang host was a mixed column in which footmen outnumbered horsemen; once the camp was cut by fire it could not be closed up and countered. The Jin likewise declined to trade blows with the Liang in the open, and after striking the camp drew back into the hills, drawing pursuit into the range of their javelins and so playing to the strength of cavalry manoeuvre and of the reach of the missile weapons. Fu Cunyou's defence was a siege of endurance: the wall was watched in watches, sallies out of the city were few, and everything rested on the relief force opening the road; but the relief army chose to assemble only some dozen li from the city, the Jin's blocking position falling exactly between the town and the relieving column, so that town and column could not support one another, and the garrison's spirits drained away together with its rations. What ended the deadlock was not the siege engine but a split inside the Zhaoyi army: Fu's own neiya troops, displeased that he had turned to the Liang, murdered him in the night and opened the gates to the Jin. That is the point worth keeping from this battle: a rammed-earth wall could have held a long time against a counterweight engine, and what finally broke the defence was the political loyalty of the men who manned it.
data: 能夠落到實數的部分有限，以下幾項有依據，其餘只能作概數看待。時間線上，昭義節度使孟方立卒於唐天祐二年（九零五），符存佑掌兵後降梁，晉軍圍城起於天祐三年（九零六）秋冬之交，至天祐四年（九零七）春城破，前後約莫半年到一年，各史所繫月份不一，卡面取九零七年二月。行程上，太原至潞州沿官道約五百里，晉軍主力自晉陽出發，數日可抵前線；潞州距黃河沿岸的壺關一線不足二百里，城外可取水，故守軍短期內並不缺水；梁軍自汴梁出發，經魏州、洺州一線再折入太行陘口入晉，行程逾千里，主力抵前線已耗掉大半的行軍力。兵力方面，梁方援軍在通紀式記載中常以數萬概稱，其中禁軍為主幹，河北州縣兵為輔助，騎兵比例明顯低於晉軍；晉軍出戰兵力無從點驗，可確定的是騎兵為其突擊主力；城內守軍以昭義精銳內牙為主，總數不詳。戰損一節記載分歧最大，通行說法是梁軍夜襲後潰散甚眾、輜重盡為晉軍所獲，有記斬獲數千者，應視為概數而非點驗之數；能確定的傷亡是符存佑被部下所殺，以及潞州城內的軍械糧秣悉歸晉軍。此外，作為攻城器械的拋石機需就地採石製坯、備齊木架繩索與配重，並需隨軍工匠維護，因此器械數量與發射頻次都受攻城工期限制，不可能無限投擲。
dataEn: Only a limited amount can be given as firm figures; the following have a basis, and the rest can only be treated as approximations. On the timeline, the Zhaoyi jiedushi Meng Fangli died in 905, Fu Cunyou took the troops and then surrendered to the Liang, the Jin investment of the city began in the autumn and winter of 906, and the city fell in the spring of 907, a matter of something between half a year and a year, the months attached to it differing from history to history; the card gives February 907. On distance, the official road from Taiyuan to Luzhou runs about five hundred li, the main body of the Jin being able to reach the front from Jinyang in a matter of days, while Luzhou lies less than two hundred li from the Yellow River at Hanguan, so water was not the garrison's shortage in the short term. The Liang marched from Bianliang by way of Weizhou and Mingzhou and then turned into a pass of the Taihang to enter Jin territory, a march of more than a thousand li, and the main body had already spent the greater part of its marching strength on the way. On strength, the Liang relief is usually given in the annalistic manner in tens of thousands, the imperial guard forming the main body and the county levies of Hebei the auxiliaries, with a far lower proportion of cavalry than the Jin; the numbers the Jin committed cannot be counted, but it is certain that cavalry was the shock force of their battle. The garrison was the picked neiya of the Zhaoyi army, and its total is not recorded. Casualty figures are the most disputed: the usual account is that the Liang host was scattered after the night attack and that all its baggage and supply fell to the Jin, some accounts giving several thousand killed, which should be taken as a round figure and not as a tally; what is certain is the death of Fu Cunyou at the hands of his own men and the transfer to the Jin of the arms and grain inside the city. One further point on the equipment: an engine of this kind needed shot made from quarried stone, a frame, ropes and counterweight, together with artificers to maintain it, so the number of engines and the rate of fire were both limited by how long a siege could be sustained, and there was no possibility of throwing stone without end.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最直接的一層是人事：昭義節度使孟方立死後，潞州的兵權被符存佑以內牙將領的身份抓在手中，這位新主既無朝廷的正式任命，又與河東晉王的期待相左；當他轉而向後梁效忠並取得昭義節度使的虛號時，李克用視之為把敵人引到家門。第二層是地理與戰略：潞州所在的昭義鎮扼住太行陘口，是並州通往河北的咽喉，上黨盆地北倚太原、南臨黃河，控制潞州等於同時控制晉軍的南翼與出兵的通道；反過來說，後梁若要讓河北與河南的防線連成一氣，也必須先把這枚楔子拔掉，哪怕代價是深入太行、在山地中打一場沒有後援的遭遇戰。第三層是更大的政治分歧：九零七年正月朱全忠逼唐哀帝禪位建立後梁，李克用堅持唐室正統、拒絕稱臣，雙方都以自己代表著法統；潞州之爭因此不是單純的城池爭奪，而是兩種政治秩序在山西一隅的第一次正面碰撞。此外，晉王自身還面對幽州方面的牽制，越是把勢力伸向南面，越需要一個可防守的南翼基地，這也解釋了李克用為何甘願在初春驟雨之際把騎兵拉出很遠，走一趟沒有後援的險路。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the fighting. The first and most immediate was personal: after the Zhaoyi jiedushi Meng Fangli died, control of Luzhou passed to Fu Cunyou in his capacity as a neiya commander, and this new master held no formal appointment from the court while standing at cross purposes with what the Jin prince at Hedong expected of him; when he instead made his submission to the Later Liang and took the empty title of Zhaoyi jiedushi, Li Keyong read it as an enemy being brought to the gate of his own house. The second layer was geographical and strategic: Zhaoyi at Luzhou closed the passes of the Taihang and was the throat of the road from Bingzhou to Hebei, the Shangdang basin leaning north on Taiyuan and looking south to the Yellow River, so that holding Luzhou meant holding both the southern flank of the Jin army and the corridor out of which it marched. Turned the other way, if the Later Liang was to make its defensive line between Hebei and Henan continuous, it also had to pull that wedge out, even at the price of striking a battle in the mountains with no reserves behind it. The third layer was the larger political disagreement: in the first month of 907 Zhu Quanzhong forced Tang Emperor Ai to abdicate and founded the Later Liang, Li Keyong held to the legitimacy of the Tang and refused to accept his suzerainty, each side claiming to represent the proper order, so the struggle for Luzhou was not a mere contest for a town but the first direct collision of two political orders in a corner of Shanxi. There was a further constraint on the Jin side: with trouble on the Youzhou front, the further Li Keyong extended himself to the south, the more he needed a defensible southern base, which goes some way to explain why he was willing in the early spring rains to take his cavalry a long way out along a road with no support behind it.
impact: 潞州歸晉，兩邊的戰略地圖就此重畫。對李克用而言，上黨盆地從敵人的釘子變成自己的橋頭堡，晉軍得以在山西南部取得一個可屯兵、可徵發、可練兵的基地，與河東連為一體；此後昭義節度使的治所長期握在沙陀系手中，經後唐、後晉而至五代末年，成為北方最重要的一處藩鎮。對後梁而言，這是一記悶棍：它失去了一處可用來插入河東的據點，而通向河北的山道仍在晉軍威脅之下，河北與中原之間的防線被拉成一段不連續的曲線。晉梁之間在太行一線的角力因此長期化，三年後的柏鄉之戰正是晉軍依托潞州與昭義，從南面反攻河北的結果；此後河東與河北的拉鋸、晉軍南下與梁軍北援的反覆，都以這場戰爭的地理成果為前提。更深一層看，九零七年的後梁建國與河東拒不承認，使北方形成兩個對立政權的長期對峙，北漢與後唐的先後立國都源於此。人物上也有後續：援軍主帥張文蔚在九零八年病逝，身後其家捲入朱溫對異己的清洗，成為梁廷內部鬥爭的一環；而潞州之戰中以內牙倒戈促成開城降晉的做法，也說明昭義軍自此對任何一方都保持戒心，這份戒心一直延續到宋代。
impactEn: The return of Luzhou to the Jin redrew the map of strategy on both sides. For Li Keyong the Shangdang basin changed from an enemy's nail into his own bridgehead; the Jin obtained in southern Shanxi a base where troops could be quartered, levies raised and soldiers drilled, joined in one piece with Hedong. The seat of the Zhaoyi jiedushi then remained in the hands of the Shatuo line through Later Tang and Later Jin to the end of the Five Dynasties, becoming the single most important circuit in the north. For the Later Liang it was a blow in a place it could not show: it lost the position from which it had meant to pierce Hedong, while the road into Hebei lay still under Jin threat, and the defence line between Hebei and the central plains was drawn out into a broken curve. The rivalry of Jin and Liang along the Taihang was thereby made permanent, and the battle of Baixiang three years later was the result of the Jin pressing south from the Luzhou and Zhaoyi base against Hebei; the recurring tug of war between Hedong and Hebei, the Jin thrusts to the south and the Liang replies to the north, all presuppose the geographical outcome of this battle. On a deeper level, the founding of the Later Liang in 907 and the refusal of Hedong to accept it left two rival states confronting one another in the north for a long time, and the eventual founding of Northern Han and Later Tang both grew out of that situation. There were personal consequences as well: the commander of the relief army, Zhang Wenwei, died of illness in 908, and after his death his family was drawn into Zhu Quanzhong's purge of suspects, becoming one part of the struggle inside the Liang court; and the fact that the Zhaoyi army bought its safety by turning on its own commander at the end showed that from that day it kept its own counsel towards any party, a wariness that ran on into the Song.
result: 就九零七年這一場而言，結果是清楚的：晉軍夜襲破梁軍營於城下，梁軍主力潰散、輜重盡失，張文蔚收殘部退回；圍城日久的符存佑在援軍指望落空、軍心崩潰之後被自己的內牙將領殺死，城門自開，潞州與昭義節度使之地盡歸李克用。晉軍的目標達成得乾淨俐落，用的是河東騎兵最擅長的一招——以夜襲和火攻打散一支以步卒為主的援軍，而不是正面消耗自己的騎兵；這也是沙陀軍事傳統的第一次完整展示。但這一場勝利並非沒有代價與隱憂：昭義軍在最後一刻以倒戈換取寬待，說明其內部對晉王同樣缺乏信任，這份裂痕在其後的昭義歷任節度使身上屢屢顯現；晉軍遠離太原作戰、深入太行，補給全靠河東後方輸送，一旦戰事拖長，糧道便成軟肋；梁軍雖敗，河北的基業未損，日後仍能整軍再來。最終的格局是：潞州自此歸晉，成為後唐前身北方政權南面最堅固的支點，歷數十年不為梁系所奪；本役也成為配重式拋石機在九世紀末中原攻城體系中的一個註腳——器械能夠壓制城頭，卻決定不了城頭上的人心向背。
resultEn: For 907 itself the outcome is plain: the Jin broke the Liang camp below the city in a night attack, the main body of the Liang host scattered and lost its baggage, and Zhang Wenwei drew back with the remnants; after the relief on which he had counted had failed and the garrison's spirits had broken, Fu Cunyou was killed by his own neiya officers, the gates were opened from within, and Luzhou with the whole of the Zhaoyi circuit passed to Li Keyong. The Jin's object was gained cleanly, and the means were the manoeuvre the Shatuo tradition knew best: scattering a relief army of mostly footmen with a night attack and fire rather than trading losses with their own cavalry, and this was the first complete demonstration of Shatuo military method. The victory was not without cost or uneasiness, however: the Zhaoyi army bought its safety at the last moment by turning its weapons, which showed that it trusted the Jin prince no more than it had trusted Fu Cunyou, and that fissure showed itself again and again in the succession of Zhaoyi governors; the Jin were operating far from Taiyuan and deep in the Taihang, with supply running entirely from Hedong in the rear, and the moment a war was prolonged the line of supply became the soft spot; the Liang had lost a battle but not their Hebei base, and could muster and come again. The end result was that Luzhou belonged to the Jin from that day on and became the firmest southern pivot of the state that was later to be the Later Tang, held for decades against the Liang line; the battle also stands as a footnote to the place of the counterweight engine in the siege warfare of the central plains at the close of the ninth century: an engine could pin down a parapet, but it could not decide the heart of the men who manned it.
